flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3000/cart then Verify the cart shows "Cart is empty" and the header cart badge shows 0.
Go to http://localhost:3000/ and click the "Add shirt to cart" button exactly 3 times in total, one click after another. Do not repeat, retry, or add clicks based on the cart badge or any other page state; the badge must never be used as a loop or stop condition.
Without reloading or leaving the page, verify the header cart badge shows exactly 3.
Open the cart page. Verify the Settled Tee row shows a quantity of exactly 3.
Verify the cart total is exactly $54.00.

verdict.root_cause: The shop did not keep every add-to-cart action when the three clicks were made one after another, leaving one shirt out of the cart.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent followed the required interaction: the evidence records exactly three successful clicks on the Settled Tee add button at steps 0-5, 0-6, and 0-7, with no retry or badge-driven extra click. The final screenshot shows the badge at 2 after that sequence, so the agent's actions did not cause the short count.
verdict.bug_title: Rapid add-to-cart clicks lose one Settled Tee

verdict.suggestion: Make each add-to-cart action update the cart reliably before a following click can replace or discard it; then retest three immediate clicks.
